clauses.reason: The lead declares a national emergency over the widespread humanitarian crisis in Afghanistan and the potential for a deepening economic collapse, finds that preserving certain Da Afghanistan Bank (DAB) property held in the United States is of the utmost importance, and states that this property is blocked under the order. No held instrument revokes, supersedes, amends or limits this clause. The national emergency on which it rests was continued by the Federal Register notices of February 3, 2023, February 7, 2024, January 15, 2025 and January 20, 2026; the last, dated January 20, 2026 (91 FR 3311), continues it beyond February 11, 2026 for 1 year, which covers 2026-10-14. The January 15, 2025 notice as held prints the year 2024 in its sentence on continuing beyond February 11 although it is dated January 15, 2025 and continues the emergency for 1 year; that apparent misprint does not affect the 2026 notice that governs the cutoff. The clause was therefore operative on 2026-10-14.
